html:
American printer, writer, scientist and diplomat, and one of the founders of the United States. Born in Boston, he ran away at seventeen to Philadelphia, where he became a successful printer and publisher of Poor Richard's Almanack.

In Philadelphia he founded a lending library, a fire company and the academy that became the University of Pennsylvania. His experiments showed that lightning is electricity, and he invented the lightning rod, bifocal glasses and an efficient stove.

In politics:

  • He spent years in London as an agent for the colonies.
  • He helped draft the Declaration of Independence in 1776.
  • As envoy to France, he won the French alliance of 1778 that helped win the war, and he helped negotiate the peace of 1783.
  • At 81 he sat in the convention that wrote the US Constitution.

He owned enslaved people for much of his life. In old age he became president of an abolition society and petitioned Congress against slavery.
sum: American printer, writer, scientist and diplomat, and one of the founders of the United States. Born in Boston, he ran away at seventeen to Philadelphia, where he became a successful printer and publisher of Poor Richard's Almanack.
